questions.question: Show that 1, 3, 6, 10, 15 has neither a constant difference nor a constant ratio, and give the next two terms.
questions.expected_answer: Differences 2, 3, 4, 5 are not constant; ratios 3, 2, 1,67… are not constant. The differences increase by 1, so the next terms are 15 + 6 = 21 and 21 + 7 = 28.

questions.question: Explain the rule of the Fibonacci sequence and give the two terms after 13.
questions.expected_answer: Each term is the sum of the two before it: 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21, 34.

questions.question: In the repeating pattern red, blue, blue, …, what colour is the 20th item? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: The pattern repeats every 3 items; 20 ÷ 3 = 6 remainder 2, so it is the 2nd item in the cycle: blue.
